card.line: "The River" in the Bible means the Euphrates, a great perennial river that marks the far edge of the land and the homeland of Abraham's family.

moments.title: Balak calls for Balaam
moments.text: Balak, king of Moab, sent messengers to Balaam at Pethor, by the Euphrates. He asked Balaam to curse the people of Israel, who had come out of Egypt.

moments.title: Abraham called from beyond the river
moments.text: Joshua reminded Israel that their fathers lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other gods. The LORD took Abraham from there and led him through the land of Canaan.

moments.title: Choose whom you will serve
moments.text: Joshua told Israel to cast aside the gods their fathers served beyond the Euphrates. He said, "As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!"

moments.title: Questions from the governor
moments.text: Tattenai, governor of the region west of the Euphrates, asked the Jews who authorized them to rebuild the temple. He then sent a letter to King Darius, and the work was not stopped.

moments.title: Nehemiah's letters for safe passage
moments.text: Nehemiah asked the king for letters to the governors west of the Euphrates. He gave them the letters, and the king also sent army officers and cavalry with him.
